title: 日本国憲法
subtitle: Constitution of Japan
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn how fundamental the constitution is to national governance.
(2) Learn about human rights protections and the respective independence of power.
(3) Learn to write a paper about current constitutional affairs.
(4) Learn to discuss current constitutional affairs
advice:
Studying current constitutional affairs as a subject.

The course will proceed in the following order:
1. Lecture or discussion
2. Quiz or essay
3. Content of next class
4. Review of quiz or essay

Read the newspaper and show interest in problems.
requiredKnowledge:
Be able to think logically and concretely.
Be interested in world events.

activityGoals.body: Be able to summarize the contents of current constitutional affairs and derive answers.
Be able to provide logically concrete explanations based on multiple factors.
Be able to understand human rights and governance structures.
Be able to self-assess the state of attainment of target abilities.
